name: Keyboard Warrior
summary: Keyboard Warrior is a top-down view shooting adventure game. On your way to your destination, there are many enemies that will stop you, you can try to avoid them, or defeat them in the same way they attack, there are no bullets, instead there are letters,but they have Added the ability to deal damage as the bullets. You need to be careful to avoid these damages, then try to defeat your enemies. There are 9 levels in the game, and the total time is about 2 hours. The style of the game is bright and relaxed, the elements of violence are downplayed, and the fighting atmosphere is rather funny.
